data.title: Butt Station holding the blueprint together
data.audience: Pinterest users who save unusual desk accessories, architecture studios, coworker gifts, and practical visual jokes
data.hook: A serious late-night drafting desk is being held together by one tiny blue seated-figure tape station.

product.name: The Butt Station blue tape-dispenser desk organizer (ASIN B08BC25ZTP)

references.lesson: Preserve one coherent blue seated figure, bent arm and clear tape roll, extended leg and foot cutter, white paperclip bowl/base, lime-yellow block, and one blue pen; never separate or duplicate the anatomy.

notes: Three product-derived concepts, stop features, click features, fidelity risks, and swap tests are recorded in the v7 README.
This product family has not appeared in a public Pin during the prior 30 days.
